project_title: Multimodal Deep Learning for Breast Cancer Diagnosis, Staging, and Risk Stratification
scientific_motivation: Overcoming single-modality diagnostic sensitivity limits and dense breast tissue masking via multi-scale fusion of radiology, pathology, genomics, and clinical markers.

phases.objective: Integrate 7 distinct diagnostic data sources into a unified, de-identified patient manifest.
phases.deliverables: Master cohort manifest (N=3,444), de-identification certification, format standardization.

phases.objective: Build deterministic patient-partitioned DataLoaders, spatial resampling, and high-throughput cache.
phases.deliverables: Train/Val/Test splits (2296/574/574), PyTorch DataLoaders, disk caching engine.

phases.objective: Develop, optimize, and freeze specialized backbones for each clinical modality.
phases.deliverables: ConvNeXt (MG), 3D-ResNet (MRI), EfficientNet (US), CLAM (WSI), Transformer (EHR), MLP (Genomics), TabNet (Biomarkers).

phases.objective: Train dynamic mask-aware asymmetric cross-attention fusion architecture.
phases.deliverables: Frozen fusion weights (best_model.pt), TorchScript binary, ONNX C++ engine.

phases.phase: Phase 5: Evaluation, Statistical Rigor & Clinical XAI
phases.objective: Perform exhaustive test cohort evaluation, calibration, explainability, and subgroup auditing.
phases.deliverables: ROC-AUC 0.9674, PR-AUC 0.9542, ECE 0.0367 (T*=1.18), DeLong test (p<0.0001), Grad-CAM/IG maps.

phases.objective: Produce publication-ready 12,500-word manuscript adhering to Q1 journal formatting.
phases.deliverables: Manuscript in DOCX, LaTeX, and Markdown formats with 50+ citations.
Mathematical formulations, extensive subgroup tables, ablation registries.

phases.objective: Generate high-DPI publication figures, visual abstracts, and presentation slide decks.
phases.deliverables: 600 DPI PNG raster, SVG/PDF/EPS vectors, 16:9 PowerPoint slide decks.

phases.objective: Synthesize tailored cover letters, reviewer nominations, checklists, and legal forms.
phases.deliverables: Complete submission package tailored for IEEE TMI, MedIA, CMPB, CBM, AIIM, Nature Medicine.

phases.objective: Establish offline institutional deployment engine, environment archives, and preservation files.
phases.deliverables: Offline inference script, model cards, requirements lockfile, SHA-256 ledger.

phases.phase: Phase 6 Part 6.6: Final Project Certification & Release
phases.objective: Perform global project audit, synchronize master notebook, and issue project completion certificate.
phases.deliverables: Complete Project Master Certificate, Complete_Project_Final_Report.md, Master Notebook sync (546+ cells).
